title: Documents
description: What you teach NIVO about your business. Every agent shares it. Add what matters to you; nothing here is required.
readOnlyNote: You can read this knowledge. Owners and managers add and change it.
loadFailBody: Refresh the page. If it keeps happening, tell us.
drawerHint: Drop files and paste links - NIVO reads and indexes them for every agent.
filesDrop: Drop files here or choose them
filesHint: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, TXT, MD, ZIP · up to 10 MB each, ZIP up to 200 MB
linksHint: Web pages, Google Docs, Sheets, Slides and Drive files. Paste several at once.
hintNoDocs: Nothing to add yet. Drop files or enter a link.
visPublicDesc: The chatbot may use it to answer customers.
batchQueued: Queued {count} documents. NIVO reads them in the background — you can close this window.
errUpload: Could not upload this file. Check your connection and try again.
errEnqueue: Could not queue this. Try again.
errNotPublic: Share the file as 'Anyone with the link'.
errFolder: Drive folders are not supported yet. Share the files one by one, or as a public doc.
errUnsupported: This type of file cannot be read. Use a web page, text, PDF or Word.
errBadType: Only .txt, .md, .csv, .pdf, .docx, .xlsx, .pptx and .zip files can be added.
errTooBig: This file is larger than 10 MB.
errBadLink: This is not a valid link.
driveAlertTitle: Let NIVO read your Google Drive to import private documents and whole folders
driveAlertBody: NIVO only reads. It never edits or deletes anything in your Drive, and you can disconnect at any time.
driveLostBody: Drive access was revoked in your Google account. Grant it again to read private files and folders.
driveErrDenied: Google Drive access was not granted.
driveErrScope: The Drive permission was left unticked on Google's screen. Grant access again and keep it ticked.
driveErrUnavailable: Google Drive access is not enabled for NIVO yet. Tell us and we will turn it on.
driveErrGeneric: Could not connect Google Drive. Try again.
errGrantLost: Drive access was revoked. Grant it again.
errNoAccess: The connected Google account cannot open this. Share it with that account.
errDriveType: This type of file cannot be read. Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDF, Word, text and CSV work.
zipSkipped: {name}: skipped {count} files that cannot be read (images, video…)
zipTruncated: The ZIP is large: only the first {count} readable files were listed.
errNestedZip: A ZIP inside a ZIP is not opened. Extract it and add it on its own.
errZipBad: This file inside the ZIP could not be opened.
errZipTooBig: This ZIP is larger than 200 MB. Split it into smaller ZIP files.
errZipTotal: This ZIP expands to more than 500 MB, so it was not opened.
errZipBomb: This ZIP looks unsafe (extreme compression), so it was not opened.
errZipEmpty: This ZIP has no readable documents.
folderTruncated: The folder is large: only the first {count} files were listed.
pickerHint: NIVO only gets the files you pick.
pickerFailed: Could not open Google Drive. Check your connection and try again.
errPickerFolder: Choose the files inside this folder (the Picker only grants access to the item you selected).
errPickerExpired: The Google Drive session expired. Choose the files again.
fieldTitleHint: A short name so you can find it later.
fieldTopicHint: Name it however you like, for example "Services" or "Approval process".
fieldContentHint: Paste or write it in your own words.
visPublic: Public (the chatbot may use it to answer customers)
fileHint: Text and Markdown files up to 120,000 characters. For a PDF, copy its text into the Text tab.
urlHint: A public web page. NIVO reads its text once; add it again to refresh.
emptyBody: Add a note, a Q&A list or a file. NIVO cuts it into passages and finds the right one when an agent needs it.
visPublicLong: Public: the chatbot may answer customers from it
visInternalLong: Internal: only internal agents and staff
passagesHint: How the source was cut. Agents retrieve these passages.
deleteConfirm: Delete this source and its passages? Agents stop using it right away.
suggestHint: Ideas based on the agents you installed. None are required: skip what does not fit your business.
suggestAllDone: Nothing more to suggest right now.
askHint: See what an agent would find. Public shows only what the chatbot may tell customers.
askPlaceholder: Ask like a customer would, for example: what are your opening hours?
askEmpty: Nothing found. An agent would say a team member will confirm.
nivoDescription: How NIVO agents work: playbooks, what they may and may not do, when they hand over, what they must learn from you, and their tone. Maintained by NIVO; you can read it but not edit it.
nivoEmpty: NIVO base knowledge has not been loaded yet.
cardNivo: {count} NIVO base items (playbook, authority, handover, tone)
cardEmpty: No business knowledge yet. Add documents so the assistant stops asking what you already wrote.
notesHint: Notes from Office and from you. They enter the agent's context when you approve.
noteRecorded: Noted in the context draft of {agent}. An owner or manager needs to approve it in Setup: /agents/{module}
